readings.Aries: There is a version of this situation that doesn't require you to fight. Try to find it. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Taurus: The plan you've been executing is yours. Make sure the goal still is. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Gemini: There's a feeling underneath the thinking. Stop analysing it long enough to feel it. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: You have been protecting others from your feelings. Consider the cost of that protection. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Leo: You are at your best when you have something to offer. Today, what are you offering? Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: Your willingness to work harder than necessary has served you. It has also cost you things. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: The version of events you're working to make fair was never quite fair to you. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Scorpio: Something you've been holding as a vulnerability is actually a source of power. Reframe it. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Sagittarius: Someone took your bluntness as cruelty. Revisit the conversation with more care for landing. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Capricorn: There is something in your past you carry as evidence of who you are. Is the evidence still current? Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the way you've been living is about to change. You've known this for a while. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Pisces: The escape you're planning will not be there when you return. What would it mean to be here instead? Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
